correctness.rationale: The primary 2026 manuscript explicitly gives a 3-type positive zero-diagonal Markov spine. Its conditional-exclusion kernel satisfies exact detailed balance with pi_i=q_i(1-q_i)/(1-sum q_j^2). The established finite-state empirical-pair LDP has rate J(Q,nu)=sum Q_ij log[Q_ij/(nu_i P_ij)] on balanced flows. Balanced zero-diagonal flows exist exactly for nu_i<=1/2. Time reversal preserves J by detailed balance and strict convexity forces a symmetric minimizer. On 3 vertices symmetry fixes Q_ij=(nu_i+nu_j-nu_k)/2, proving uniqueness and explicit rate including boundaries. Strict uniqueness and the joint LDP yield conditional flow concentration at interior compositions. The result is analytical; the standalone finite code passes 13,502 checks and is only supplemental.

originality.rationale: Blancas–Fittipaldi–Hernandez-Torres (arXiv:2610.20896v1) identifies the mutation family and spine but gives no occupation LDP. Monthus (arXiv:2101.09045v3) gives a general level-2.5 flow variational formula, which covers the raw Markov LDP but not the explicitly solved three-allele contraction and q-independent conditioned transition law. Original contribution is confined to the sharp feasibility triangle, unique zero-circulation optimizer, closed cost, and resulting bias cancellation. Relevant published-finding corpus records and primary literature were queried. Hsia (1976) is a close predecessor based on an abstract only and is a residual literature risk.
residual_risks: Hsia 1976 full occupation-time result not accessible: an explicit discrete-time or limiting asymptotic comparison remains unverified.
Good 1961 exact Markov frequency-count formulas could encode the rate via a longer asymptotic derivation.

The generic finite-state Markov empirical pair-flow theorem mathematically implies a variational expression; novelty/value are claimed only for proving the exact nontrivial three-state entropy minimizer, universality and sharp domain, not for the general LDP.

value.rationale: The new 2026 mutation-spine model naturally asks for atypical long-run allele profiles. The exact closed rate on the sharply constrained triangle and the unique q-independent conditional rare-transition law distinguish impossible, exponentially expensive and typical compositions and describe their most likely microscopic origin. The result is a motivated complete three-type classification; finite computations are not used as value justification.
